units.source_text: 薰大将虽然气度安闲，举止端详，但逢到了恋爱之事，自然也会身心交困。

en.t: Although General Kaoru was calm in bearing and dignified in conduct, when it came to love he too naturally suffered in both body and mind.

units.source_text: 何况那好色的匂亲王，自从浮舟死后，哀情无法宽慰。

en.t: How much more, then, was the amorous Prince Niou unable to console his grief after Ukifune's death.

units.source_text: 连可以当作浮舟的遗念而相与其诉哀情的人也没有。

en.t: He did not even have anyone who could serve as a keepsake of Ukifune and with whom he could share his sorrow.

units.source_text: 只有他的夫人二女公子，有时说“浮舟可怜”。

en.t: Only his wife, the Second Princess, would sometimes say, "Poor Ukifune."

units.source_text: 然而她和这异母妹并不是从小一起长大，而是最近才见面相识的，所以对她的同情并不甚深。

en.t: But she and this half sister had not grown up together from childhood, and had only recently met and become acquainted, so her sympathy for her was not very deep.

units.source_text: 而匂亲王也不好意思在妻子面前任意说“浮舟可爱，浮舟可怜”。

en.t: And Prince Niou was too embarrassed to freely say before his wife, "Ukifune was dear, poor Ukifune."

units.source_text: 因此他把一向在宇治的侍从接到了二条院来。

en.t: For that reason, he brought Jijuu, who had long been in Uji, to Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 宇治山庄中自浮舟死后，侍女们纷纷散归，只有乳母和右近、侍从三人，不忘旧情，还守在那里。

en.t: At the Uji villa, after Ukifune's death, the serving women scattered and went home; only the nurse, Ukon, and Jijuu, three people in all, did not forget their old attachment and remained there.

units.source_text: 侍从对浮舟虽然并不十分亲密，但也暂时陪着乳母和右近做话伴。

en.t: Although Jijuu had not been especially close to Ukifune, for the time being she stayed with the nurse and Ukon as a companion in conversation.

units.source_text: 当初听到这荒凉的宇治川的水声，确信希望在前，可以自慰，而现在只觉得凄凉可怕。

en.t: At first, when she heard the sound of the desolate Uji River, she had comforted herself by believing that hope lay ahead, but now she felt only loneliness and fear.

units.source_text: 后来侍从终于辞别宇治，来到京都，住在一个简陋的地方。

en.t: Later, Jijuu finally took leave of Uji, came to Kyoto, and lived in a humble place.

units.source_text: 匂亲王派人去找她，对她说道：“你到这里来当差吧。”

en.t: Prince Niou sent someone to look for her and said to her, "Come here and serve me."

units.source_text: 她感谢匂亲王的好意，但念这地方对她的旧主人浮舟有复杂关系，深恐众侍女纷纷传说，言语不堪入耳，因此不愿住在二条院，要求到明石皇后那里当侍女。

en.t: She was grateful for Prince Niou's kindness, but considering that this place had complicated ties with her former mistress Ukifune, she deeply feared the serving women would spread unbearable gossip, and so she did not wish to live at Nijo-in, but asked instead to serve Empress Akashi.

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“这样很好。

en.t: Prince Niou said, "That is very good.

units.source_text: 你在那边，我可以私下差使你。”

en.t: If you are over there, I can make private use of your services."

units.source_text: 侍从思念到了宫中，可以消遣孤苦无依之情，便找人说情，到明石皇后那里当了宫女。

en.t: Jijuu thought that if she went to court she might distract herself from her lonely and helpless feelings, so she found someone to speak for her and became a court lady in Empress Akashi's service.

units.source_text: 别的宫女觉得此人身份虽低，然而相貌不坏，人品也好，便无人歧视她。

en.t: The other court ladies felt that although her rank was low, she was not unattractive and had a good character, so no one looked down on her.

units.source_text: 薰大将也常常来此，侍从每次见到他，总觉不胜感伤。

en.t: General Kaoru also often came there, and whenever Jijuu saw him, she was always overcome with emotion.

units.source_text: 她以前听别人说，皇后那里有许多身份高贵的、像小说中所描写的千金小姐。

en.t: She had previously heard people say that at the Empress's residence there were many high-ranking young ladies like those described in tales.

units.source_text: 现在她留心察看，渐渐觉得竟没有比得上她的旧主人浮舟的人。

en.t: Now, as she observed them carefully, she gradually came to feel that none of them could compare with her former mistress Ukifune.
